scope: NativeCapture standalone WPF cross-build, exact-source useful-pixel predicate checks, read-only automatic UI capture flow inspection

standaloneBuild.actualTarget: net10.0-windows WPF class library containing the unchanged production NativeCapture.cs only; compile on Linux, not Windows execution

usefulPixelsChecks.actualTarget: net10.0 console harness on Linux, with HasUsefulPixels extracted unchanged from the production source; no Win32/WPF screenshot methods executed

checked: Automatic flow checks CanAutoCapture before hiding helper windows.
Main, update window and overlay are hidden before a cancellable 180ms settle delay.
Automatic worker calls CaptureGame, which rechecks window identity, foreground and captured frame validity.
Main/update restoration uses ShowActivated=false; overlay constructor also sets ShowActivated=false.
No direct Activate call exists in the ordinary automatic capture/restore branch.
Unknown recognition fields are not marked confirmed; screenshots invalidate old advice and require manual review.
The accepted-frame bool prevents failed/cancelled capture from being described as a successful new screenshot.
An attempted automatic capture consumes its trigger; failure does not requeue it or cause indefinite timer retries.

items.issue: Capture failure was announced as a new screenshot.
items.resolution: CaptureSnapshotAsync returns Task<bool>; FollowTick displays success only when a new frame was actually accepted.

items.issue: An attempted but failed automatic capture requeued the same trigger for indefinite timer retries.
items.resolution: FollowTick consumes readyFollowTrigger before attempting capture and does not put it back on failure. A failed attempt waits for the next log event or manual F8; a not-yet-attempted trigger may still wait while the game is not foreground.

limitations: No Windows UI, hotkey, DPI, actual game, DirectX, foreground switching or occlusion test was executed on this Linux machine.
PrintWindow is a synchronous Win32 call and cannot be guaranteed cancellable; IsHungAppWindow is a preflight mitigation, not a hard timeout.
Process identity is bound by HWND plus PID, using the existing Chinese/English title selection; no unverified executable-name allowlist was invented.
Screen fallback is conservative and may reject usable scenes; these checks do not prove complete prevention of all possible occlusion or rendering artifacts.
Flat-frame predicate tests do not measure game OCR or screenshot recognition accuracy.
